text:
Mia (Growth): Heads-up — for the product launch next Tue we're compressing the email sequence into a short, high-intensity surge: warmup -> launch -> webinar invite within 48h. Goal: drive demo signups + webinar RSVPs without spamming repeat audiences.

Sam R: Sounds good. Which audience slices are we targeting for the surge? Control vs prioritized?

Mia (Growth): Priority: 14-day signups (open rate > 25%), trialers who used >1 feature, and marketing-qualified leads from webinar landing page. Control: broad weekly newsletter cohort.

Jasper (Bench): Can we surface a single benchmark stat in the launch email? Prefer something crisp that supports the message (latency/cost win).

Adele (Content): Suggested stat: "Reduce inference cost by up to 3x with Redwood Optimize" — short line + CTA to benchmark report. I can draft 2 headline variants.

Leo (Email Ops): Sending windows proposal (PST): warmup 9am, launch 11am, webinar invite 3pm. If anyone objects speak now. Also need suppression rules.

Sam R: A/B test plan: subject line A (benchmark-first) vs B (feature-first). Split 10% holdout per segment for uplift measurement. Metrics: open, click, demo-submit, webinar-RSVP.

Mia (Growth): Holdout is good. KPIs: demo-submit rate + CPQL. Threshold to stop surge: if unsubscribe > 0.4% or complaint > 0.05% in any segment.

Adele (Content): Draft subjects: 1) "See how teams cut LLM cost by 3x (free benchmark)" 2) "Ship LLM features faster — a real customer story". Short preheader for both.

Leo (Email Ops): Suppression rules: global unsub + last 7-day send >=2 -> exclude. Also exclude users who attended last month's webinar. I exported segment CSV: attendee_flag, last_open, signup_date.

marketing-bot: Preview generated — https://redwood.ai/preview/launch-surge-1715502468 (preview token valid 24h) :rocket:

Jasper (Bench): Quick note on the benchmark narrative: keep the stat contexted — include baseline (median across SaaS workloads) and one sentence about methodology. Adele can link the full report.

Adele (Content): Will add a short methodology blurb and link to the report on the landing page. Also planning a 2-line testimonial for the launch email.

Sam R: Quick check — do we want an early-bird promo (priority demo slots)? If yes, put a CTA button "Claim demo slot" in the launch email.

Mia (Growth): Yes, limited demo slots as FOMO. 48-hour claim window. We'll route claimed demos to AE queue "Launch_Surge". Sam: can you set up tracking tag?

Sam R: Yep — will append utm_campaign=launch_surge_171550 and event=demo_claim.

Leo (Email Ops): Implementation note — for the launch send use throttled ramp: 10% -> 40% -> 50% over 30m to monitor bounces. Config snippet for send schedule: 

```
send_schedule:
  - pct: 10
    wait: 00:05:00
  - pct: 40
    wait: 00:10:00
  - pct: 50
    wait: 00:15:00
```

Sam R: A/B variant mapping:
- Variant A: subject A, CTA "See benchmark" -> landing /benchmark?utm_campaign=launch_surge
- Variant B: subject B, CTA "Request demo" -> /demo?utm_campaign=launch_surge

Mia (Growth): Action items: Adele draft copy by EOD Fri; Leo prepare suppression CSV + ramp config; Sam set tracking + A/B in ESP; Jasper final stat + report link. We'll reconvene Mon 10am for final sign-off.

Leo (Email Ops): Noted. Also flagging deliverability check Friday morning (seedlist + ISP test).

Adele (Content): I'll post copy here when ready. Draft will be short (60-80 words) + 1 CTAs.

Jasper (Bench): I'll attach a one-pager with methodology and a screenshot of the latency/cost chart to the landing page.

Sam R: I'll create the A/B split in ESP and add tracking events.

Mia (Growth): Thanks — main risk is perception of too many sends. We'll keep creative tight and offer clear opt-out. :thumbsup:

marketing-bot: Reminder set: reconvene at 1715760000 (Mon 10am PST) for final sign-off.
